request: an app for my shop stock. Include items with quantity and a minimum level, highlighted when low, a reminder every Saturday morning to check, prices and the total value of everything and a category (Dry, Fresh, Frozen).
program:
app "Stock" package ink
table item name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 10, price money?, kind pick Dry|Fresh|Frozen
let short = countof(item, it.qty <= it.low)
text short "items running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
each item sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sumof(item, it.qty * it.price) faint
form item
remind "Check your items" at 9:00 on sat

app "Dentist floss" tooth ocean
table floss
setting target num = 7
let n = count(floss today)
draw width 240 tap add floss
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * clamp(n / target, 0, 1) stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 46, n big
  label 50, 64, "of" target faint
stat count(floss), "all time"
when n = target notify "Target reached"

table point team pick Dad|Son, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Dad)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Son)
setting winat num = 7 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Dad" bold
    text a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Dad, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Dad, pts = 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Son" bold
    text b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Son, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Son, pts = 2
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
if a >= winat
  "Dad win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Son win!" head color good

request: Track my shop customers. It should have a list of customers and for each an entry with amount and Gave or Got, showing the balance, a phone number for each person, a note on each entry, the date of the last entry under each name and an optional due date on each entry.
program:
app "Khata" wallet mint
table person name text, phone text?
table entry person ref person, amount money, kind pick Gave|Got, due date?, note text?
"People owe you" sum(entry.amount where kind = Gave) - sum(entry.amount where kind = Got) big
each person as p
  let bal = sum(p.entry.amount where kind = Gave) - sum(p.entry.amount where kind = Got)
  stack card tap edit p
    row
      p.name bold grow
      if(bal >= 0, "owes you", "you owe") abs(bal) color if(bal >= 0, good, bad)
    "Last entry" last(p.entry.at) faint
form person, "Add person"
form entry, "Add entry"
log entry

request: gym owner tool: members, fees due, trainer schedule, check-in attendance, and a list of memberships about to expire, name the app "Gym Pro".
program:
app "Gym Pro" dumbbell slate
table member name text, fee money, due date, ends date
table checkin member ref member
table trainer who text, day pick Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat|Sun, start time
"Check-ins today" count(checkin today) big
"Fees due" head
each member where due <= today sort due
  row card
    it.name grow
    it.fee bold color bad
"Memberships ending in 14 days" head
each member where ends - today <= 14 and ends >= today sort ends
  row card
    it.name grow
    it.ends color warn
"Members" head
each member sort name
  row card
    it.name grow
    button "Check in" tap add checkin member = it
    button "Paid" tap set it.due = addmonths(it.due, 1)
"Trainer schedule" head
each trainer sort start
  row card tap edit it
    it.day it.start it.who
form member, "Add member"
form trainer, "Add trainer slot"

request: A month calendar where each day shows a coloured dot for every workout I did, use a purple look.
program:
app "Workouts" dumbbell plum
table workout kind pick Run|Gym|Yoga|Walk = Run
state m date = today
monthnav m
grid 7 gap 1
  each ["M", "T", "W", "T", "F", "S", "S"] as w
    text w size tiny color muted align center
  each 1..weekday(m - monthday(m) + 1) - 1
    box
  each days month of m as d
    stack height 44 radius 6 pad 1 fill soft
      monthday(d) size tiny
      row gap 0
        each workout on d
          draw width 10
            circle 50, 50, 40 fill if(it.kind = Run, accent, if(it.kind = Gym, good, if(it.kind = Yoga, warn, bad)))
row gap 1
  each options workout.kind
    button "+" it tap add workout kind = it

request: I feel low sometimes and want to see if there is a pattern, i want to call it Daily Mood Pattern.

table mood score num 1..5, note text?
state sc num = 3
row gap 1

button "Save today's mood" tap add mood score = sc

heat last 70 days, avg(mood.score on it), 5

log mood

program:
app "Score Keeper" ball plum
table ball runs num 0..6 = 0, wide bool, out bool
setting overs num = 20
let legal = count(ball today where wide = no)
let runs = sum(ball.runs today) + count(ball today where wide = yes)
let wkts = count(ball today where out = yes)
text runs "/" wkts big
"Overs" floor(legal / 6) + legal % 6 / 10 "of" overs ". Run rate" round(runs * 6 / legal) faint
row gap 1
  each [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6]
    button it tap add ball runs = it
row gap 1
  button "Wide" tap add ball wide = yes
  button "Out" fill bad tap add ball out = yes

row gap 1
  each ball today sort at desc top 6
    draw width 36
      circle 50, 50, 46 fill if(it.out, bad, if(it.runs >= 4, good, soft))
      if it.out
        label 50, 50, "W" bold
      else
        label 50, 50, it.runs bold

request: A clock face with my sleep shown as a coloured arc from bedtime to wake-up time. Green theme please.
program:
app "Sleep Clock" bed mint
setting bed time = 23:00 "Bedtime"
setting wake time = 7:00 "Wake-up time"
let a = 360 * (((bed - 0:00) / 1h) % 12) / 12
let b = 360 * (((wake - 0:00) / 1h) % 12) / 12
draw width 220
  circle 50, 50, 46 stroke edge thick 1
  arc 50, 50, 38, a, if(b > a, b, b + 360) stroke accent thick 6
  label 50, 8, "12" size tiny
  label 92, 52, "3" size tiny
  label 50, 96, "6" size tiny
  label 8, 52, "9" size tiny
  label 50, 50, ((wake - bed) / 1h + 24) % 24 big
"Bedtime" bed "Wake-up" wake head

request: A card for each upcoming event with a coloured strip showing days left until the date, colour: dark.
program:
app "Events" calendar ink
table event name text, day date
each event where day >= today sort day
  stack card gap 1
    draw 100, 6
      rect 0, 0, 100, 6 fill soft radius 3
      rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(1 - (it.day - today) / 30, 0.05, 1), 6 fill if(it.day - today <= 3, bad, if(it.day - today <= 10, warn, good)) radius 3
    row
      it.name bold grow
      it.day - today "days left"
form event, "Add event"

request: A big progress circle showing the percent of my loan paid and the balance left in large text. Default loan amount 1500000.
program:
app "Loan" coin slate
setting loan money = 1500000 "Loan amount"
table payment amount money
let paid = sum(payment.amount)
let p = clamp(paid / loan, 0, 1)
stack align center gap 1
  draw width 220
    circle 50, 50, 42 stroke soft thick 10
    arc 50, 50, 42, 0, 360 * p stroke accent thick 10
    label 50, 50, round(p * 100) "% paid" big
  "Balance left" faint
  if(loan > paid, loan - paid, 0) big size huge
form payment, "Add payment"
log payment

request: A flashcard with the word on the front, and a tap to flip it and see the meaning on the back. Colour: dark and moody.
program:
app "Flashcards" cards ink
table flash word text, meaning text
state i num = 0
state flipped bool = no
each flash sort at as c
  if index = i
    stack card gap 2 pad 4 align center tap set flipped = not flipped
      if flipped
        c.meaning big
      else
        c.word big
      "Tap to flip" faint
row gap 1
  button "Previous" tap set i = clamp(i - 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
  button "Next" tap set i = clamp(i + 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
text i + 1 "of" count(flash) faint
form flash, "Add card"

request: study app: subjects, a weekly timetable, a pomodoro timer, flashcards and a weekly progress chart. Use a mint green look.
program:
app "Study" school mint
table subject name text
table lesson subject ref subject, day pick Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat = Mon, start time, mins num 15..180 = 45
table studied subject ref subject, mins num 1..
table flash word text, meaning text
setting work dur = 25m "Focus length"
state i num = 0
state flipped bool = no
state sub ref subject
screen plan "Timetable" calendar
  each options lesson.day as dd
    stack gap 1
      text dd bold
      each lesson where day = dd sort start as l
        row card tap edit l swipe remove l
          l.start l.subject.name grow
          l.mins "min"
  form lesson, "Add lesson"
  form subject, "Add subject"
screen focus "Focus" timer
  choice sub
  timer work, "Focus", add studied subject = sub, mins = 25 then notify "Break time"
  sum(studied.mins today) "min studied today" head
screen cards "Cards" cards
  each flash sort at as c
    if index = i
      stack card gap 2 pad 4 align center tap set flipped = not flipped
        if flipped
          c.meaning big
        else
          c.word big
  row gap 1
    button "Previous" tap set i = clamp(i - 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
    button "Next" tap set i = clamp(i + 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
  form flash, "Add card"
screen progress "Progress" chart
  daybars last 7 days, sum(studied.mins on it)
  share subject, sum(it.studied.mins week), it.name

app "Daily Study" school ocean
table subject name text
table lesson subject ref subject, day pick Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat = Mon, start time, mins num 15..180 = 45
table studied subject ref subject, mins num 1..
table flash word text, meaning text
setting work dur = 25m "Focus length"
state i num = 0
state flipped bool = no
state sub ref subject
screen plan "Timetable" calendar
  each options lesson.day as dd
    stack gap 1
      text dd bold
      each lesson where day = dd sort start as l
        row card tap edit l swipe remove l
          l.start l.subject.name grow
          l.mins "min"
  form lesson, "Add lesson"
  form subject, "Add subject"
screen focus "Focus" timer
  choice sub
  timer work, "Focus", add studied subject = sub, mins = 25 then notify "Break time"
  sum(studied.mins today) "min studied today" head
screen cards "Cards" cards
  each flash sort at as c
    if index = i
      stack card gap 2 pad 4 align center tap set flipped = not flipped
        if flipped
          c.meaning big
        else
          c.word big
  row gap 1
    button "Previous" tap set i = clamp(i - 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
    button "Next" tap set i = clamp(i + 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
  form flash, "Add card"
screen progress "Progress" chart
  daybars last 7 days, sum(studied.mins on it)
  share subject, sum(it.studied.mins week), it.name

request: log my car fuel fills with date, liters, price, odometer. Show km per liter and next oil change reminder every 3000 km. Start the oil change every at 4500.
program:
app "Car fuel" car slate
table refuel liters num 0.., price money, odo num 0..
table oil odo num 0..
setting interval num = 4500 "Oil change every (km)"
let km = max(refuel.odo) - min(refuel.odo)
let used = sum(refuel.liters) - first(refuel.liters)
let since_oil = max(refuel.odo) - last(oil.odo)
round(km / used * 10) / 10 "km per liter" big
"Since last oil change" since_oil "km" head
if(since_oil >= interval, "Oil change due now", "Km to next oil change") color if(since_oil >= interval, bad, muted)
text interval - since_oil "km left" faint
when since_oil >= interval notify "Oil change is due"
button "Oil changed now" tap add oil odo = max(refuel.odo)
form refuel, "Add fill"
log refuel

app "Fitness" run mint
table steps count num 0..
table workout kind text, mins num 1..300
table weigh kg num 20..300
table water ml num 1..5000
let w_now = last(weigh.kg)
sum(steps.count today) "steps today" big
sum(workout.mins week) "workout min this week," sum(water.ml today) "ml water today" head
form steps, "Add steps"
form workout, "Log workout"
form weigh, "Log weight"
quick water, ml, [1000, 2000]
trend weigh, it.kg
"Weekly summary" head
stack card gap 1
  if(sum(steps.count week) > sum(steps.count prev week), "Steps up", "Steps down or the same") "vs last week" color if(sum(steps.count week) > sum(steps.count prev week), good, warn)
  if(sum(workout.mins week) > sum(workout.mins prev week), "More workout minutes", "Fewer workout minutes") color if(sum(workout.mins week) > sum(workout.mins prev week), good, warn)
  if(sum(water.ml week) > sum(water.ml prev week), "More water", "Less water") color if(sum(water.ml week) > sum(water.ml prev week), good, warn)
  if(avg(weigh.kg week) < avg(weigh.kg prev week), "Weight down", "Weight not down") color if(avg(weigh.kg week) < avg(weigh.kg prev week), good, muted)

request: A tile for each room in my house, coloured by how long ago it was last cleaned, name the app "Clean rooms Plus".
program:
app "Clean rooms Plus" home mint
table room name text
table clean room ref room
grid 2 gap 1
  each room sort name as r
    let ago = since(r.clean)
    stack card gap 1 pad 2 fill if(count(r.clean) = 0, bad, if(ago <= 3, good, if(ago <= 7, warn, bad))) tap add clean room = r
      r.name bold color bg
      if(count(r.clean) = 0, "never cleaned", "days since cleaned") color bg size small
      text ago big color bg
"Tap a room when you clean it." faint
form room, "Add room"

request: ROSCA app: members, monthly contribution, whose turn it is each month, and payment tracking, start the monthly contribution at 7500.
program:
app "Committee" users plum
table member name text, ord num 1..60
table pay member ref member, amount money
table payout member ref member
setting contribution money = 7500 "Monthly contribution"
let turn_no = count(payout) % count(member) + 1
"This month's turn" head
each member where ord = turn_no as m
  stack card gap 1
    m.name big
    "gets" contribution * count(member) faint
    button "Pot given" tap add payout member = m
count(pay month) "of" count(member) "have paid this month" head
each member sort ord as m
  row card gap 1
    m.ord bold
    m.name grow
    if(count(m.payout) > 0, "Received", "") color good faint
    if count(m.pay month) > 0
      "Paid" color good
    else
      button "Paid" tap add pay member = m, amount = contribution
form member, "Add member"

request: A study planner for my board exam in six subjects. Set the exam date, list topics per subject, mark each topic studied, rate my confidence 1 to 5, and show a daily plan with the next three topics I should do, make it plain grey.
program:
app "Board exam" school slate
table subject name text
table topic subject ref subject, name text, studied bool, conf num 1..5 = 3 "Confidence"
setting exam date = today "Exam date"
text exam - today "days to the exam" big
count(topic where studied = yes) "of" count(topic) "topics studied" head
"Today's plan: next 3 topics" head
each topic where studied = no sort conf top 3 as t
  row card gap 1
    stack grow
      t.name bold
      t.subject.name "confidence" t.conf faint
    toggle t.studied
each subject as s
  stack card gap 1
    s.name bold
    count(s.topic where studied = yes) "of" count(s.topic) "studied" faint
    each s.topic as t
      row gap 1 tap edit t
        toggle t.studied
        t.name grow
        t.conf "/ 5"
form subject, "Add subject"
form topic, "Add topic"

request: birthday and anniversary list with reminders a week before, gift ideas column, and budget for each event. Colour: blue.
program:
app "Special days" gift ocean
table event name text, kind pick Birthday|Anniversary = Birthday, day date, alert date, gift text?, budget money?
state n text = ""
state k pick Birthday|Anniversary = Birthday
state dt date = today
state g text = ""
state b money = 0
field n "Name"
choice k
field dt "Date"
field g "Gift idea"
field b "Budget"
button "Add" tap add event name = n, kind = k, day = dt, alert = dt - 7, gift = g, budget = b then set n = "" then set g = ""
remind "An event is coming in a week" at event.alert
remind "Event today" at event.day
each event sort day as e
  row card gap 1 tap edit e swipe remove e
    stack grow
      e.name bold
      e.kind e.day faint
      e.gift faint
    e.budget
    if e.day < today
      button "Next year" tap set e.day = addmonths(e.day, 12) then set e.alert = addmonths(e.alert, 12)
"Budget for upcoming" sumof(event where day >= today, it.budget) faint

request: rental property app: units, tenants, rent due dates, a repairs log and receipts. I want to call it Rentals Pro.
program:
app "Rentals Pro" home slate
table flat name text, rent money, due_day num 1..31 = 1
table tenant name text, flat ref flat, phone text?
table rentpay flat ref flat, amount money, receipt image?
table repair flat ref flat, what text, cost money?, done bool
screen units "Flats" home
  each flat as u
    row card gap 1 tap edit u
      stack grow
        u.name bold
        "rent" u.rent "due on day" u.due_day faint
      if count(u.rentpay month) > 0
        "Paid" color good
      else
        "Unpaid" color if(monthday(today) > u.due_day, bad, warn)
  form flat, "Add flat"
screen tenants "Tenants" users
  list tenant
  form tenant, "Add tenant"
screen rents "Rent" wallet
  stat sum(rentpay.amount month), "collected this month"
  form rentpay, "Record rent and receipt"
  each rentpay as r
    row card tap edit r
      r.flat.name bold grow
      r.amount
      image r.receipt
screen repairs "Repairs" pen
  each repair where done = no as r
    row card tap edit r
      toggle r.done
      r.flat.name r.what grow
  form repair, "Add repair"
  log repair where done = yes

request: A pie chart of my monthly electricity bill split by appliance, which I type in myself, use a ocean blue look.
program:
app "Electricity" bolt ocean
table bill appliance text, amount money
let total = sum(bill.amount)
draw width 220
  each bill sort at as b
    arc 50, 50, 25, 360 * sumof(bill, if(it.at < b.at, it.amount, 0)) / total, 360 * (sumof(bill, if(it.at < b.at, it.amount, 0)) + b.amount) / total stroke if(index % 5 = 0, accent, if(index % 5 = 1, good, if(index % 5 = 2, warn, if(index % 5 = 3, bad, muted)))) thick 50
"Total bill" total big
each bill sort at as b
  row
    b.appliance grow
    round(b.amount * 100 / total) "%" bold
form bill, "Add appliance"

request: Monthly household budget with categories rent, groceries, school, transport, medicine and eid savings. Enter each expense with date and category. Show a bar for each category against its monthly limit, red when I go over. Name the app "Household Buddy".
program:
app "Household Buddy" home mint
table expense what text, amount money, category pick Rent|Groceries|School|Transport|Medicine|Eid_savings, note text?
setting lim_rent money = 30000 "Rent limit"
setting lim_groceries money = 20000 "Groceries limit"
setting lim_school money = 10000 "School limit"
setting lim_transport money = 5000 "Transport limit"
setting lim_medicine money = 3000 "Medicine limit"
setting lim_eid money = 5000 "Eid savings limit"
state m date = today
monthnav m
"Spent this month" sum(expense.amount month of m) big
each options expense.category as k
  let spent = sum(expense.amount month of m where category = k)
  let lim = if(k = Rent, lim_rent, if(k = Groceries, lim_groceries, if(k = School, lim_school, if(k = Transport, lim_transport, if(k = Medicine, lim_medicine, lim_eid)))))
  stack gap 1
    row
      text k bold grow color if(spent > lim, bad, ink)
      text spent "of" lim
    draw 100, 4
      rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
      rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(spent / lim, 0, 1), 4 fill if(spent > lim, bad, accent) radius 2
form expense
log expense month of m

  each question sort at as x

        x.q head

else
  "Your score" score "of" total big
  button "Play again" tap set qi = 0 then set score = 0
form question, "Add question"

request: simple monthly budget: income, expenses by category and what is left. Make it purple.
program:
app "Budget" wallet plum
table spend what text, amount money, category pick Food|Bills|Travel|Fun|Health
setting budget money = 80000 "Monthly budget"
state m date = today
state cat text = ""
let spent = sum(spend.amount month of m)
monthnav m
if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
goal spent, budget, "spent"
"Safe to spend" round((budget - spent) / (monthdays(m) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day. Last month:" sum(spend.amount prev month) faint
draw 100, 50
  line 0, 50, 100, 0 stroke edge
  poly stroke accent thick 2
    each days month of m
      pt 100 * monthday(it) / monthdays(m), 50 - 50 * clamp(sum(spend.amount month of m where at <= it) / budget, 0, 1)
each spend month of m by category
  stack tap set cat = if(cat = it.key, "", it.key)
    row
      it.key grow
      sum(it.amount) bold
    draw 100, 3
      rect 0, 0, 100 * sum(it.amount) / spent, 3 fill if(cat = it.key, accent, muted)
form spend
log spend month of m where cat = "" or category = cat

request: habit tracker with week strips for each habiit and a 10 week heat grid. make it ocean blue.
program:
app "Habits" check ocean
table habit name text
table check habit ref habit
let n = count(habit)
let done = count(check today)
row gap 2
  ring done, n, "done today"
  stack grow
    if(done = n and n > 0, "All done today", "Keep going") head
    "Best streak" maxof(habit, streak(it.check)) "days" faint
if n = 0
  "Start with one small thing you can do on a busy day." faint
each habit as h
  stack card gap 1 tap edit h swipe remove h
    row gap 2
      h.name bold grow
      streak(h.check) "days" faint
      toggle h.check
    row gap 1
      each days last 7 days
        stack grow align center tap toggle h.check on it
          dayname(it) size tiny color muted
          box height 10 radius 5 fill if(count(h.check on it) > 0, accent, soft)
row gap 2
  stat round(count(check week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))), "% this week"
  stat round(count(check last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)), "% last 30 days"
"Last 10 weeks" head
grid 7 gap 1
  each days last 70 days
    box height 12 radius 2 fill if(count(check on it) > 0, accent, soft) opacity clamp(count(check on it) / n, 0.3, 1)
"Each row is a week. Darker means more habits done." faint
form habit

request: a tic tac toe game for two players on one phone. I want it green.
program:
app "Tic tac toe" board mint
table move game num, cell num 1..9, mark pick X|O
setting cur num = 1 "Game"
let n = count(move where game = cur)
let turn = if(n % 2 = 0, "X", "O")
let win(m text) = countof([123, 456, 789, 147, 258, 369, 159, 357], count(move where game = cur and mark = m and (cell = floor(it / 100) or cell = floor(it / 10) % 10 or cell = it % 10)) = 3) > 0
let xw = win("X")
let ow = win("O")
if xw or ow
  if(xw, "X", "O") "wins!" big
else
  if(n = 9, "Draw", turn) if(n = 9, "", "to play") big
grid 3 gap 1
  each 1..9 as c
    if count(move where game = cur and cell = c) = 0 and not xw and not ow
      box height 80 radius 8 fill soft tap add move game = cur, cell = c, mark = turn
    else
      box height 80 radius 8 fill surface
        last(move.mark where game = cur and cell = c) big align center
button "New game" tap set cur = cur + 1

request: calculator for zakat on my savings and for tips on a bill. Set "Cash and bank" to 5.

app "Zakat and tip" calc slate
setting cash money = 5 "Cash and bank"
setting gold num = 0 "Gold (grams)"
setting silver num = 0 "Silver (grams)"
setting gold_rate money = 0 "Gold price per gram"
setting silver_rate money = 0 "Silver price per gram"
setting debts money = 0 "Debts due now"
state bill money = 0
state tip num = 10
state people num = 1
let wealth = cash + gold * gold_rate + silver * silver_rate - debts

screen zakat "Zakat" coin
  field cash
  field gold
  field silver
  field gold_rate
  field silver_rate
  field debts
  if(wealth >= nisab, "Zakat due (2.5%)", "Below nisab: no zakat due") faint
  round(if(wealth >= nisab, wealth * 0.025, 0)) big
screen split "Tip" calc
  field bill "Bill"
  "Tip" tip "%" faint
  slider tip 0..30
  "People" people faint
  slider people 1..20
  "Tip" round(bill * tip / 100) head
  "Each pays" round(bill * (1 + tip / 100) / people) big

request: I want to see what happens if I save a fixed amount every month for some years at a yearly return. Let me change the amount, the percent and the years, and show the final amount with a bar for each year.
program:
app "Growth" chart mint
state pay money = 5000
state rate num = 10
state years num = 10
field pay "Saving each month"
"Yearly return %" rate faint
slider rate 0..30
"Years" years faint
slider years 1..30
let fv(y num) = if(rate = 0, pay * 12 * y, pay * (pow(1 + rate / 1200, 12 * y) - 1) / (rate / 1200))
"After" years "years" faint
compact(fv(years)) big
"You put in" compact(pay * 12 * years) faint

state working bool = yes

request: character sheet for our tabletop game with hit points bar, plus and minus buttons for hp, and a d20 button that remembers the last 5 rolls

request: hi, track my daily habits: a list where I tick off my daily habits each day, the percent done this week, two tabs: today and history, the percent done in 30 days, a streak count for each one, a time of day for each one (morning, afternoon or evening) and a reminder at 9 pm, plus send the report to my boss by email.
program:
app "Habits" check ocean
table habit name text, part pick Morning|Afternoon|Evening = Morning
table check habit ref habit
let n = count(habit)
screen main "Today" check
  count(check today) "of" n "done today" head
  each habit
    row card gap 2 tap edit it swipe remove it
      stack grow
        it.name bold
        streak(it.check) "day streak" faint
        it.part faint
      toggle it.check
  form habit
screen stats "Stats" chart
  stat round(count(check week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))), "% done this week"
  stat round(count(check last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)), "% in 30 days"
remind "Time to tick off daily habits" at 21:00

request: Track my shop stock: a list of items with a count for each and plus and minus buttons, prices and the total value of everything, an expiry date for each item, red when it is over and a reminder every Saturday morning to check. And look up the weather online each day.
program:
app "Stock" package ink
table item name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 2, price money?, expires date?
let short = countof(item, it.qty <= it.low)
text short "items running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
each item sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      "Expires" i.expires faint color if(i.expires < today, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sumof(item, it.qty * it.price) faint
form item
remind "Check your items" at 9:00 on sat

table craft_item name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 5, price money?, expires date?
state q text = ""
let short = countof(craft_item, it.qty <= it.low)
text short "items running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each craft_item where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      "Expires" i.expires faint color if(i.expires < today, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sumof(craft_item, it.qty * it.price) faint
form craft_item
remind "Check your items" at 9:00 on sat

request: A score keeper for a carrom match: two big score boxes for Us and Them with plus 1 buttons, undo and a new game button, play to 25 and show who won, the lead between them, a history of every point and extra buttons for +2 and +3
program:
app "Carrom" board ink
table point team pick Us|Them, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Us)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Them)
setting winat num = 25 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Us" bold
    text a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Us, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Us, pts = 2
      button "+3" tap add point team = Us, pts = 3
  stack card grow align center
    "Them" bold
    text b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Them, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Them, pts = 2
      button "+3" tap add point team = Them, pts = 3
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
if a >= winat
  "Us win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Them win!" head color good
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
list point

table student name text, phone text?
table fee_entry student ref student, amount money, kind pick Fee|Paid, due date?, note text?

form student, "Add student"
form fee_entry, "Add entry"
log fee_entry
